entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chit Phumisak was a Thai Marxist historian, activist, author, philologist, poet, songwriter, and communist revolutionary. His most influential book was Chomna Sakdina Thai, written in 1957 under the pseudonym Somsamai Sisutphan. Other pen names used by Chit include Kawi Kanmueang (กวีการเมือง) and Kawi Si Sayam. He has been described as the "Che Guevara of Thailand".
